title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - IntentReport
description: IntentReport is the mechanism to report back to Intent owner on an Intents status (TM Forum TMF921 Intent Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component IntentReport; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:IntentReport:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'IntentReport'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'IntentReport' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:IntentReport:<tmfId>. unique identifier

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/IntentReport/properties/description'. The description of the intent report.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/IntentReport/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

intent.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/IntentReport/properties/intent'. Intent Ref (if Intent already exists) or Value (if Intent be created or its details be presented). In TMF this is a IntentRefOrValue object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Intent entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Intent:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/IntentReport/properties/name'. The name of the intent report.

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/IntentReport/properties/creationDate'. Date and time of the creation of this intent report

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

iri.description: Internationalized Resource Identifier of the intent Expression

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
